what: Readings of TI CSD18510Q5B (SLPS632, March 2017), v2/vendor/battery/ti-csd18510q5b.pdf, page 6: Figure 10 (Maximum Safe Operating Area, single pulse, max RthJC 0.8 C/W, case 25 C) and Figure 8 (normalized on-state resistance against case temperature), for record l9stk's protection design (MESHSAT-1357, 4 October 2026)
method: the page rendered with pdftoppm at 300 dpi and cropped to the figure (x 380, y 1290, 840 by 600 pixels); each straight segment of a curve read at its two end points in that crop's pixels; the axes calibrated on their labelled gridlines; a current at a drain voltage is the log-log interpolation along the segment. Reading uncertainty about 3 pixels, which is 5 percent in current; the record carries 10 percent
rdson_normalized_note: Figure 8 at VGS 10 V reads about 1.8 at a 150 C case, the figure's right end (typical curve, ID 32 A); used as the bound for the conduction loss at the junction limit
